about: familia skills catalog. green-zkillz (inside brianreborn/green-agentz) is the home for bundled skills; this file is the selection layer. Format: skills/README.md. Survey source: familia #67.

skills.name: Green-Zkillz pipeline
skills.description: Runs the adaptive skill pipeline in order: probe, bootstrap, ingest, format, deploy.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: Green Probe
skills.description: Checks the host tier, file-descriptor privileges and identity posture before other green-zkillz skills run.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: Green Bootstrap
skills.description: Writes a Makefile and runtime env files from a green-probe status line; keeps CI logs non-interactive.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: Green Ingest
skills.description: Indexes a workspace tree or collects prose and code turn by turn, then runs light syntax checks.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: Green Format
skills.description: Normalizes markdown to the green-zkillz style guide and maps sources into MANUSCRIPT.json chapters.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: Green Deploy
skills.description: Publishes green-zkillz artifacts to X, Git, or a flat MANUSCRIPT.md. Only on an explicit request naming the channel.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: etioz (requirements matrix)
skills.description: Turns the artifacts you give it (prose, transcripts, code, mockups) into a Software Requirements Matrix. Design, not implementation.
skills.attribution: Copyright (c) 2026, Brian Reborn. green-zkillz, BSD 3-Clause (docs/green-zkillz/LICENSE in green-agentz).

skills.name: ARTEMIS Android automation
skills.description: On-demand Hermes Agent skill for Google ARTEMIS Android automation without a permanent MCP server in context.
skills.attribution: pank-su/artemis-android-skill (Apache-2.0); keep LICENSE and any NOTICE when vendoring.
skills.notes: Skill count 1 (SKILL.md + scripts/). Drives an Android device: adds tools. Vendored into green-zkillz @ f94430ff6248 (green-agentz #18).

skills.name: GoClaw skills/ set
skills.description: 8 SKILL.md folders (anysearch, docx, goclaw, pdf, pptx, skill-creator, workspace-organizing, xlsx) plus _shared, from the GoClaw framework repo.
skills.blocked_reason: Repo is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial) and skills/pdf is Anthropic proprietary (forbids redistribution). Cherry-picking needs a per-file audit first.
